title: Dark and Bright Side of Participatory Red-Teaming with Targets of Stereotyping for Eliciting Harmful Behaviors from Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Participatory red-teaming where individuals stigmatized by academic elitism (graduates of non-prestigious regional universities in South Korea) use adversarial prompting strategies to intentionally elicit, document, and evaluate discriminatory responses from LLMs, alongside measuring the psychological impact of the task on the participants themselves.
